description: Phase parent for the graph-engineering research program: six completed deep-research studies on how to evolve the in-house system-deep-loop engine into a graph-based agent-loop system over the designated-but-dark 036 authority plane. Studies 1-4 are the graph layer (agent-swarms runtime, graphene event/belief, graph-arch governance, graph-engineering-master knowledge doctrine); study 5 is the loop/harness layer (NOOA paper + blog theory); study 6 is the cross-study integration capstone that welds them into one design (spine + eight unified artifacts P1-P8 + resolved tensions + one integrated architecture). Program map: context-index.md; handover: handover.md.
